description:
Hooke & MacDonald are delighted to present this 2 bedroom apartment located in Clonsilla. The apartment comprises of 2 double bedrooms, 2 bathroom, living area and kitchen. 

Living & dining area combined. The apartment is spacious and the development includes well maintained grounds and gardens. A host of amenities are available on the doorstep including shops, parks and schools, while nearby Clonsilla Train Station provides service to Phoenix Park, Connolly Station and Docklands. Viewings advised.
